nodes.label: State.AddTransition
nodes.rationale: Prefer State reference (rename-safe); use path when bare name ambiguous since Godot only enforces unique sibling names.

nodes.label: StateMachine (driver node)
nodes.rationale: Delivers processing from its own _Process/_PhysicsProcess walking only the active configuration, so inactive states cost nothing.

nodes.label: revolverCylinderBone
nodes.rationale: Never renamed because action channels bind to bones by name string.

nodes.label: revolverCylinderRotationBone
nodes.rationale: Coincident disconnected child of revolverCylinderBone so Godot can add 6-chamber indexing spin on top of animation without disturbing existing keyframes.

nodes.label: SkeletonModifier3D Cylinder Spin (_ProcessModification)
nodes.rationale: Runs after the AnimationPlayer each frame so the 60-degree-per-shot indexing composites on top of the reload swing-out.

nodes.label: SubViewport Viewmodel Lighting Bug
nodes.rationale: Known Godot limitation: SubViewport camera sharing World3D does not reliably receive DirectionalLight3D/WorldEnvironment contribution.

nodes.label: Microsteps and 64-Transition Loop Cap
nodes.rationale: Queued transitions drain within one tick so transient chains resolve in one frame; >64 per frame assumed to be a loop.

nodes.label: Player Movement Statechart Example (Grounded/Airborne/Stamina)
nodes.rationale: Movement and Stamina regions meet only through Player.Stamina field, so adding regions costs nothing to others.

nodes.label: Transition Domain (LCA exit/entry sets)
nodes.rationale: Domain uses proper ancestors so self-transitions exit and re-enter, enabling animation restart or timer re-roll.

nodes.label: First Person View Model Shader (Godot Shaders, Riordan/Kastor)
nodes.norm_label: first person view model shader (godot shaders, riordan/kastor)

nodes.label: Rig Edit Failure Rules (disconnected, coincident, full reweight, deform on)
nodes.norm_label: rig edit failure rules (disconnected, coincident, full reweight, deform on)
nodes.rationale: Connected bones drag parent tail changing rest basis; off-axis pivot wobbles; partial weights blend; non-deform bones ignored; Blender 4.4+ action slots may unbind.

nodes.label: Projection-Matrix Viewmodel Shader (Option A)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: keeps mesh in world camera pass so lighting is correct; trade-offs are losing StandardMaterial3D inspector, imperfect depth scaling, and needing shadows disabled.

nodes.label: SubViewport with Duplicated Lights / Cull Mask (Option B)
nodes.norm_label: subviewport with duplicated lights / cull mask (option b)
nodes.rationale: Not preferred: every relevant light must be tracked and given viewmodel layer 2 in its cull mask.

nodes.label: Deepest-Source-Wins Priority
nodes.rationale: Child transitions shadow parent ones; when a parent condition must always win, child guards must exclude it.

nodes.label: Hierarchical State Machine (Statechart)
nodes.rationale: Flat FSMs explode combinatorially; compound states hoist shared transitions and parallel states make independent regions n+m instead of n*m. States are Godot nodes so the scene tree is the diagram.

nodes.label: Hoisted Edge to Terminal State Must Exclude It
nodes.norm_label: hoisted edge to terminal state must exclude it
nodes.rationale: Without !_dead.Enabled the Dead state re-entered every frame, resetting the corpse removal timer; without !Alive on children, Chase/Attack ping-ponged forever.
